label: Gazelle (ajax.php)
description: Gazelle tracker using ajax.php — the standard API endpoint shipped by upstream Gazelle and present on essentially every fork, so this is the type to reach for first when adding a new Gazelle site. API-key auth on it is a newer per-fork addition (upstream used the session cookie). The key identifies the current user, so no username is required. Profile pages use ID-based URLs (/user.php?id=N).
